ValidationRule.description: Requires a Second Upsell Type for One Time Shred, RM, and Shred
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
ISPICKVAL( Deal_Type__c , "Upsell"),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Second_Service_Line__c,'DB&R'), ISPICKVAL(Second_Service_Line__c,'RM'), ISPICKVAL(Second_Service_Line__c,'Shred'), ISPICKVAL(Second_Service_Line__c,'One Time Shred')), ISBLANK(TEXT(Second_NCSP_Upsell_Type__c)), ispickval( Opportunity__r.Type , "Up-Sell/Lift") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a Second Upsell Type
